items.title: Earl Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: it was strictly, well a little bit advanced from Turk, but they were like traditional — trad.

ctx.x: And the place was swamped. And the second week, the same thing. Because people had heard Scobey’s recordings, and it was the Frisco jazz, and it was strictly, well a little bit advanced from Turk, but they were like traditional — trad.
Yeah, the traditional revival thing going on there.
